D: A blue supervillain finally beats his hero and finds out being on top is boring.
P: Serve the mains when Megamind, disguised as Bernard, takes Roxanne out to dinner.
S: Tortillas filled with chicken, cheddar, mozzarella and capsicum

Flour tortillas filled with shredded chicken, melting cheese and capsicum, toasted crisp in a dry pan and cut into wedges with salsa and sour cream. Mix 200g shredded cooked chicken with 200g grated cheddar and mozzarella, 1 diced red capsicum, 2 sliced spring onions and half a teaspoon smoked paprika. Spread over half of each of 4 large flour tortillas and fold over. Cook in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and the cheese has melted. Cut each into 4 wedges and serve with tomato salsa and sour cream.
Crisp cheddar and smoked paprika crackers
Cheese crackers cut into fish shapes, baked at 180C for 12 minutes, served in a round glass bowl like a fishbowl.
Metro City pretzel bites and honey mustard
the Metro Man museum in Metro City

Soft pretzel bites boiled briefly in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with a honey mustard dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 30g melted butter and 250ml warm water and knead 5 minutes. Rest 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb and drop the bites in for 20 seconds. Drain onto a lined tray, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp mayo to dip.
M: Megamind disguised as Bernard on a date with Roxanne

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, seared and roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and herbed rice. Mix 200g ricotta, 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper. Cut a pocket into 4 chicken breasts and stuff. Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 1.5 cups basmati with 20g butter and stir through chopped parsley and chives. Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon and 1 crushed garlic clove. Slice the chicken over the rice and spoon over the lemon butter.
Beef chuck slow simmered with chipotle, cumin and kidney beans
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick, served with sour cream and cornbread.
W: Cocoa buttermilk cupcakes tinted blue, piped with frosting
Velvet cupcake batter of buttermilk and a little cocoa tinted blue, baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with cream cheese frosting.
K: Cold cola poured slowly over vanilla ice cream in chilled glasses

Two scoops of vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with cold cola poured slowly over so it foams up high, topped with dark chocolate shavings. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each. Pour 300ml very cold cola slowly down the side of each glass, stopping to let the foam settle before topping up. Shave 30g dark chocolate over the foam with a peeler and serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw.

s.how: Rub 100g butter into 150g flour, then mix in 150g grated cheddar and a pinch of smoked paprika. Add cold water to bring together and chill 30 minutes. Roll thin, cut into fish and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Serve in a round glass bowl.

m.note: Beef chuck slow simmered with chipotle, cumin and kidney beans
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add a can of crushed tomatoes, a spoon of cumin, 2 chopped chipotles and water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours, adding 2 cans of kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream.

w.note: Cocoa buttermilk cupcakes tinted blue, piped with frosting
